title: Good-Faith Relief for Part-Paid Microsoft 365 Annual Invoices
content:
A client who has paid part of a Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) annual cycle invoice receives good-faith relief on the late charge. The relief is measured against the payments applied to that invoice, compared with the invoice's cycle charges and prorated charges.

| Payments applied to the invoice | Late charge multiplied by |
|---|---|
| at least 25 percent of its cycle and prorated charges | 0.5 |
| something, but less than 25 percent | 0.75 |
| nothing paid on it | no relief |

**Reading the test.**

- Only payments applied to this invoice count. Credits on the invoice are not payments.
- The 25 percent is measured against the invoice's cycle and prorated charges. The past-due balance is not the measure.
- A payment of exactly 25 percent earns the 0.5 multiplier.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical invoice with cycle and prorated charges of 8000.00 USD)

| Payments applied | Share | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 2000.00 | exactly 25 percent | 0.5 |
| 1999.99 | just under 25 percent | 0.75 |
| 100.00 | 1.25 percent | 0.75 |
| 0.00 | nothing | no relief |

A late charge of 60.00 USD before relief becomes 30.00 at 0.5, and 45.00 at 0.75.
